This is a senior-level software engineering role (6+ years) on Samsara's Commercial Navigation team, working remotely from the US or Canada. The product is in-app navigation for commercial fleets — turn-by-turn guidance in the Samsara Driver app, fuel-aware and optimized routing, and session review tooling for fleet managers — built on real-time telematics and geospatial data under unreliable connectivity. The work spans mobile, backend services, and web, with React Native for the driver app plus Swift and Kotlin for native and in-cab modules.
